title: UNI’s Metal Casting Center partners with METAL to provide workforce training in casting and forging for K-12 students and professionals
summary_en: The UNI Metal Casting Center is proud to announce a partnership with the Metallurgical Engineering Trades Apprenticeship & Learning program, led by IACMI – The Composites Institute®, to enhance and scale up industry-driven training opportunities for current and prospective metalworking and manufacturing professionals.
title_cn: UNI’s Metal Casting Center partners with METAL to provide workforce training in casting and forging for K-12 students and professionals

title: UNI MBA marks 20 years as a Princeton Review Best Business School
summary_en: The UNI MBA has earned The Princeton Review's Best Business Schools distinction for the 20th consecutive year, offering an affordable, flexible program designed to help professionals advance their careers in as few as 10 courses.
title_cn: UNI MBA marks 20 years as a Princeton Review Best Business School
